text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(...I also got her a present, but giving it<n>to her might
just bring her misfortune.<n>So I think... I'll stick to a
simple<n>birthday wish...)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Hooray, yippee! ♪ Rice wished<n>me a happy
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm suuuper-duper happy you<n>remembered, Rice! I
wanna hear you<n>say it again! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rice! Say it again! I wanna<n>hear you say it
one more time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-happy birthday! ...U-uuh, this is a<n>little
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Urara's so happy... Meanwhile, I'm<n>here feeling all
afraid... Be brave,<n>Rice... and give her the present!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Instead of saying it again, what<n>if I handed you
my present... Is that<n>okay?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! You have a present for<n>me?! Yippity-yay!
What is it, what is<n>it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I still wanna hear you<n>wish me a
happy birthday a few more<n>times. ♪ Again, again!
Say it again!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Urara... Hehe, sure thing. I'll keep<n>saying it until
you're happy!
